findings.finding: Q3 order intake will carry at least NOK 11.5bn of disclosed air-defence contracts (Belgium NASAMS NOK 10bn, Netherlands CITADEL ~NOK 1.5bn, both signed 29 Sept) and possibly the ~USD 400m Kuwait NASAMS subcontract the Q2 report said would be booked once formalised, so book-to-bill should rebound from Q2's 1.64 that Morgan Stanley flagged as a slowdown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: order intake +53% y/y but book-to-bill down from 2.9 to 1.64, cited as part of the -6.8% day; Q1 2026: NOK 27bn intake, +5.1% day; the Belgium order itself moved the stock +4.8% on 2026-09-30.
findings.original_quote: Nederland: 'Kontrakten har en verdi på ca. 1,5 milliarder kroner og inkluderer flere NOMADS-systemer ... samt en utvidelse av NASAMS luftvernsystemet.' (The contract is worth about NOK 1.5bn and includes several NOMADS systems ... and an extension of NASAMS.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: Belgium was an inside-information release and the stock rose 4.8% on it. What may not be is the Kuwait booking (no separate release announced its formalisation) and the arithmetic that Q3 book-to-bill likely exceeds 2x on a ~10.7bn revenue bar; if fully priced the stock would not have given back the Belgium day within a week (-2.6%, -1.1% on 10-01/10-02).
findings.independence: Peer read: Saab's Q3 order bookings SEK 65.8bn vs ~56bn expected (Inderes), https://www.inderes.se/releases/saab-q3-results-2026-positioned-to-capture-growing-demand -- same demand cycle, different company.

findings.finding: Pareto removed Kongsberg Gruppen from its Norwegian model portfolio for October (swapping into Kongsberg Maritime), with E24 headlining the analyst's reason as 'Kan skuffe' (may disappoint), on top of Q2's margin miss whose stated causes (Ukraine donation mix in Defence Systems, Zone 5 US ramp, Discovery relocation) the company did not say were over.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin is the line this stock trades on: Q2 2026 EBIT margin 16.1% vs ~17% consensus -> -6.8%; Q3 2025 weaker quarter (with spin-off announcement) -> -18.3%; Q2 2025 -> -12.1%.
findings.original_quote: 'Pareto bytter Kongsberg-aksjer: – Kan skuffe' / 'Analytiker forklarer hvorfor Kongsberg Maritime kommer inn i varmen i oktober, mens Kongsberg Gruppen forsvinner ut.' (Pareto swaps Kongsberg shares: 'may disappoint' / Analyst explains why Kongsberg Maritime comes in from the cold in October while Kongsberg Gruppen goes out.) Body paywalled; only headline and lede read. Q2 report: 'Marginen ... endte på 17,7 prosent i år mot 19,6 prosent i fjor, som et resultat av endret produkt- og prosjektmiks, blant annet knyttet til norske donasjonsprosjekter til Ukraina.'
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is flat over 20 and 60 days (-2.3%, +0.2%) rather than down, so the caution has not been sold into; the body of the Pareto argument is paywalled and the Swedish wire carried only the swap, not the reason. If priced, KOG would have lagged Saab through October; it moved roughly in line.
findings.independence: Q2 report's own outlook language that margin 'vil kunne variere mellom kvartaler' (https://storage.mfn.se/c/aHR0cHM6Ly9hcGkzLm9zbG8ub3Nsb2JvcnMubm8vdjEvbmV3c3JlYWRlci9hdHRhY2htZW50P21lc3NhZ2VJZD02NzgwNDAmYXR0YWNobWVudElkPTMyOTU0NQ/kog-kvartalsrapport-norsk.pdf); Placera wire of the swap, https://www.placera.se/telegram/nordic-semiconductor-paretos-norska-portfolj-slog-index-i-september-tre-byten-infor-oktober-20261001

findings.finding: Closest listed peer Saab reported Q3 on 23 Oct with order bookings of SEK 65.8bn against ~56bn expected and the CEO saying demand shows no levelling off; Saab rose 1.8% that day while KOG slipped 0.2%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history of KOG reacting to Saab's print; on 2026-10-23 it did not react.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer read-through the KOG price ignored on the day (-0.2%); demand is not what KOG has been missing on, margins are, so its value is small.

baseline_tension: Lean (+0.12) and run-up (20d -2.3%, 5d +1.2%) are flat; the evidence is also balanced, so nothing cuts hard against them -- the slight negative tilt comes from the name's habit of selling results days, not from a sourced unseen number.
language_note: E24 (Norwegian, 2026-10-04) carried the reason line for Pareto's October portfolio exit -- 'Kan skuffe' (may disappoint) -- where the Swedish/English wires (Placera, Finwire) carried only the swap itself.

E24 (Norwegian, 2026-10-27) ran a Q3 preview framing the print as a 'dragkamp' (tug-of-war) with demand unchallenged; no English preview found, but its body is paywalled so it added framing, not numbers.
The Norwegian Q2 quarterly report PDF is the same content as the English release; the issuer publishes both languages simultaneously, so the filing added nothing language-specific.
lessons_applied: 'Finding about a number the market has already been told is worth ~0': orders finding cut +0.5 -> +0.3 since Belgium was an inside-information release the stock already reacted to.
'Bar unsourced -> cap findings small' and 'a proxy is a hypothesis': Pareto finding (headline-only analyst view) cut -0.8 -> -0.6; Saab peer read cut +0.3 -> +0.2.
'Size the move on what is new; reaction history moves p_up, not abs': abs_move_pct raised 6.0 -> 6.5 (new numbers base ~7%, no guidance change expected, own results-day median 6.8%); p_up left at 47.
